choices.reason: No rule resolves the AUT-versus-PIT tie: the paper names creative performance generally as primary, and its abstract reports novelty for both tasks without prioritizing either. Neither task provides the participant-level summaries or data_stats required by rule 3; task order was randomized, no combined estimate is reported, and the remaining rules do not select one task.
choices.locator: PDF p. 2, Abstract; p. 9, section 2.2; p. 10, section 2.3; p. 17, Table 2 and section 3.2.2; pp. 21-22, Table 4 and sections 3.3.1-3.3.2.
choices.quote: In both AUT and PIT tasks, human−AI collaboration showed significantly higher idea novelty and more frequent perspective-taking than human−human collaboration.
